_doc: Bridge conformance fixture — typical SnapshotPayload emitted by the Task 1.5 worker on ControlCommand::Snapshot or supervisor poll. Carries every open cell across every symbol plus the cumulative ticks_processed counter. The cells_open array is a flat list of CellDelta values where the _delta fields hold the running absolute totals (deliberate shape reuse so the WS-side wsSnapshotPayloadSchema.cellsOpen accepts them without a renaming pass). The companion .msgpack file is the byte-level oracle. Hand-edit this JSON to change the logical value, then regenerate via `cargo run --bin gen-fixtures`. NEVER hand-edit the .msgpack file.
